items.message: `_current` calls `self.workspace.guard.check_read` but `_edit` also calls `self._current` before passing the result to `self.workspace.record`; a symlink whose target is outside the tree returns `None` from `_current` (the `inside` check), which surfaces as 'no file at' rather than a read refusal.

Docs say a bare `AiStrategy` subclass is 'handed `write_file`, `edit_file`, `delete_file` and `run_script`' but no corresponding update to any capability-check or registration test confirms `edit_file` is part of the `AGENCY` capability set.
